title: Brand Guidelines v1.0 — 2.25.22
slide_intent: Introduce the identity at a scale where the reader can recognize the signature before studying its parts.
strategic_value: A single strong appearance of the full lockup can establish a visual reference for the component studies that follow.
demonstration: A small edition line and a large carrot-and-wordmark lockup occupy opposite ends of a dark green field.
practical_value: Use the cover to compare the full lockup with later pages that isolate its symbol or letters.

content_islands.name: Edition line
content_islands.spec: Set the version and date in a small pale line at the upper left.

content_islands.name: Cover lockup
content_islands.spec: Align the arrow and orange root with the pale lowercase name near the bottom. Let the lockup span nearly the entire width.
